infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Lyne uses your location to estimate when you should leave for your queue.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationUsageDescription: Lyne sends queue updates and departure reminders.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Lyne uses the camera to scan your ID, TRN or passport so agencies can verify you faster.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Lyne lets you upload a photo or document of your ID, TRN or passport.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Lyne uses Face ID to protect your saved documents and sensitive details.
